conventions: lowercase snake_case logical names; no spaces
sprites are PNG, fonts TTF/OTF (or the TMP atlas if conversion is lossy)
9-slice borders and pivot/PPU belong in assets/game/manifest.json, not in the name
groups nest one level: ui/icon/brain_input/00 (two-digit index)
in-world overlays use the same ui/ tree (they are UI-ish art)

prefab_only_note: All UI chrome (panels/buttons/sliders/toggles/dropdowns/icons/fonts) is wired through Unity prefabs in the level scenes; the decompiled C# exposes field names but not the sprite assets. Entries with prefab_only=true must be resolved by extracting the referenced prefabs (level0..level4 / globalgamemanagers) and matching the field/role. field_inventory lists every such field with a heuristic expected_logical; treat those heuristics as a starting point, not ground truth.
